--- src/primitives/block.cpp ---
18-21: uint256 CBlockHeader::GetHash() const { return SerializeHash(*this); }
   // SerializeHash = double-SHA256 of the serialized header — the BLOCK
   // IDENTITY hash is sha256d for EVERY block regardless of PoW algo.
   // MinotaurX/Hive are the GetPoWHash() mining-validity functions only.
   // Verified live: sha256d(header) reproduces the daemon-reported hash for
   // type-1 (minotaurx) mainnet blocks at heights 4480797 and 4480789
   // (2026-11-16 UTC).
